svg.title: BLIP-2 pipeline
svg.desc: A frozen EVA-CLIP ViT produces patch features; a trained 188M Q-Former with 32 queries gives 32 tokens; a linear projection feeds a frozen LLM (OPT or FlanT5).

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: BLIP-2: a small pretrained Q-Former bridges two frozen models
